newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds gains, ends steadier.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds gains, ends steadier.

text.p: White sugar futures remained higher during Monday evening trading, against a background of steady levels in New York, although conditions were largely routine.
Traders said the market was gearing up for the December expiry at the end of this week.

Some white premium business was also reported, but although the London market was firmer following the open of the New York market, the steady raws performance was not enough to spur more bullish sentiment, traders said.
At the close December was 70 cents higher at $307.50 and March up $0.80 at $306.50.Volume totalled 3,869 lots.
Open interest in spot December has fallen sharply since the start of this month, while that in March has soared and gently climbed in May.
The Paris market was closed, due to a public holiday on account of Armistice Day.
